label: Replaceable support survives all-world local grounding and direct-edge asymmetry
description: Tests the root-route no-contingent-concrete-support premise dd41c165-129a-59d3-84ce-bd13c0944901 consumed by NecessaryConcreteUnderived and its from-necessity assembly. Adds the same target at every world, everywhere contingent support of it, all-world coverage of contingent intermediaries, endpoint soundness and cross-world direct-edge asymmetry to the existing switching pattern. The existing note docs/notes/underived-essence-identity.md records the strongest positive essential-support argument, its burden, rival identity/adequacy obligations and revision conditions.
